goals.text: See all notes in the order they were created.
Create a note with text and receive it with its id.

terms.name: note
terms.definition: A stored piece of text that the notes service keeps in memory and identifies by an id.

terms.name: note text
terms.definition: The text of a note. It must be non-empty; an empty string is not accepted.

terms.name: note id
terms.definition: The identifier of a note. The first note created receives id 1, and each later note receives the next integer id.

rules.response: shall return all notes in creation order

rules.trigger: a client creates a note with non-empty text
rules.response: shall store the note and return it with its note id

rules.trigger: a client creates a note with empty text
rules.response: shall reject the request with status 400 and store no note

examples:
Feature: Notes

  Rule: R-1

    @R-1 @E-1
    Scenario: Listing with no notes returns an empty list
      Given there are no notes
      When a client lists notes
      Then the response status is 200
      And the response is an empty list

    @R-1 @E-2
    Scenario: Listing returns notes in creation order
      Given there is a note with id 1 and text "buy milk"
      And there is a note with id 2 and text "walk dog"
      When a client lists notes
      Then the response status is 200
      And the response is a list of the notes with id 1 and id 2, in that order

  Rule: R-2

    @R-2 @E-3
    Scenario: The first note created receives id 1
      Given there are no notes
      When a client creates a note with text "buy milk"
      Then the response status is 201
      And the response contains a note with id 1 and text "buy milk"

    @R-2 @E-4
    Scenario: A later note receives the next id
      Given there is a note with id 1 and text "buy milk"
      When a client creates a note with text "walk dog"
      Then the response status is 201
      And the response contains a note with id 2 and text "walk dog"

  Rule: R-3

    @R-3 @E-5
    Scenario: A note with empty text is rejected
      Given there are no notes
      When a client creates a note with text ""
      Then the response status is 400
      And a client lists notes and the response is an empty list
contract:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Notes service
  version: 1.0.0
  description: An in-memory notes service that lists notes and creates notes.
paths:
  /notes:
    get:
      operationId: listNotes
      summary: List notes
      description: Returns all notes in creation order.
      x-rules: [R-1]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: All notes in creation order.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Note"
    post:
      operationId: createNote
      summary: Create a note
      description: "Stores a note with non-empty text and returns it with its id."
      x-rules: [R-2, R-3]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/NewNote"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: The created note.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Note"
        "400":
          description: The text is empty.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
components:
  schemas:
    Note:
      type: object
      required: [id, text]
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        text:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
    NewNote:
      type: object
      required: [text]
      properties:
        text:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [message]
      properties:
        message:
          type: string

questions.text: Is text made only of spaces or line breaks also rejected as empty?
options: No, only the empty string is rejected
Yes, whitespace-only text is rejected too
